mapper.insert: INSERT INTO charge_rate (user_id, type, charging_station_id, anonymous, score, comment, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{chargingStationId}, #{anonymous}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id AS rateId, cr.user_id AS userId, ui.name AS username, cr.score, cr.comment, cr.anonymous, DATE_FORMAT(cr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, ui.avatar FROM charge_rate cr LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON cr.user_id = ui.id WHERE cr.charging_station_id = #{stationId} AND cr.type = #{stationType} AND cr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cr.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM charge_rate WHERE id = #{rateId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE charge_rate SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{rateId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
